metadata.title: Capa.PowerShell.Module.SDK.Authentication
metadata.description:
PowerShell module for CapaInstaller SDK containing functions for Authentication functions.
	For more information, see https://capasystems.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CI65DOC/pages/19382173123/SDK+-+CapaInstaller+Software+Development+Kit+functions

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Initialize-CapaSDK' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
